closure: Entropy content is sampled from the exact enumerated no-follow file handle while its parent is held. Typed root/file identity, size, modification-generation, and bounded entropy/SHA-256/length receipts are revalidated while the exact root and file are held through scoring and event publication. Namespace or sample uncertainty increments skipped/errors, sets complete=false, and lowers health.

The BYOVD action remains absent from executable ACTIONS, has no service mutation sink, and can only produce an inert proposal. Every direct, transactional, rollback, and verification path fails closed and cannot retain ok=true.

Evidence is copied from the frozen source handle into a new exclusive single-link inode, fsynced, SHA-256 sealed, reread, renamed relative to the held quarantine root, and periodically revalidated from its digest-bearing receipt name before the original link is retired. Alias residue and custody drift lower health. Trip-alert state expires inside every trip, is capped at 256, and cap saturation lowers health.
